_comment: klocal configuration. Commit this file. Replace every PROJECT placeholder.
_secret: klocal never touches secret values. It runs `hook` from the project root with
KL_NAMESPACE, KL_SECRET, KL_SECRET_ENV_FILE and KL_KUBECTL exported, and the
hook is responsible for creating the Secret. Piping a vault straight into
kubectl keeps every value out of both the filesystem and the model transcript:
Inside the hook use $KL_KUBECTL, not bare kubectl: it carries the --context
klocal verified, whereas a bare kubectl follows whatever the kubeconfig says
at that moment. Set hook to "" if the project has no secrets yet.
_tls: Only needed when the app refuses non-https origins, or when it sets __Host-
cookies (which are unconditionally Secure). See references/bring-up.md.
